steps.title: Prepare Biotin‑BSA stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg bovine albumin, biotin‑labeled (1 000 µg/mL) in 10 mL sterile 1× PBS (4 °C); filter through a 0.2 µm filter, aliquot 200 µL, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Biotin‑BSA working solution
steps.instruction: Mix 180 µL Biotin‑BSA stock (1 000 µg/mL) with 1 440 µL sterile 1× PBS to a total of 1 800 µL (final 100 µg/mL); prepare fresh before use.

steps.title: Prepare NeutrAvidin stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg NeutrAvidin protein (1 000 µg/mL) in 10 mL sterile 1× PBS (4 °C); filter through a 0.2 µm filter, aliquot 20 µL, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare NeutrAvidin working solution
steps.instruction: Combine 20 µL NeutrAvidin stock (1 000 µg/mL) with 1 980 µL sterile 1× PBS to a total of 2 000 µL (final 10 µg/mL); prepare fresh before use.

steps.title: Prepare BSA 0.2 % solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.1 g BSA (2 000 µg/mL) in 50 mL sterile 1× PBS (4 °C); filter through a 0.2 µm filter, aliquot 2 mL, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare anti‑CD16 solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL biotin anti‑human CD16 antibody (1.67 µg/mL) to 299 µL BSA 0.2 % solution (2 000 µg/mL) to obtain 300 µL; prepare fresh before use.

steps.title: Prepare HER2 stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 20 µg recombinant human HER2/ERBB2 protein (3 440 nM) in 65.9 µL sterile 1× PBS (–20 °C); aliquot 5 µL and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare HER2 working solution
steps.instruction: Mix 5 µL HER2 stock (3 440 nM) with 1 715 µL BSA 0.2 % solution (2 000 µg/mL) to a total of 1 720 µL; prepare fresh before use.

steps.title: Prepare RPMI supplemented medium
steps.instruction: Combine 445 mL RPMI 1640, 50 mL FBS (10 %), and 5 mL GlutaMAX 100× (1 %) to 500 mL total; filter through a 0.22 µm filter and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Rinse chamber wells with DPBS
steps.instruction: Rinse each well of an 8‑well uncoated Ibidi slide with 200 µL sterile DPBS at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Coat wells with Biotin‑BSA
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Biotin‑BSA working solution to each well, incubate 30 min at RT on a see‑saw rocker set to 20 oscillations/min; ensure full well coverage.

steps.title: Rinse Biotin‑BSA coating
steps.instruction: Remove the Biotin‑BSA solution and rinse each well four times with 200 µL sterile DPBS at RT, avoiding contact of the pipette tip with the well bottom.

steps.title: Coat wells with NeutrAvidin
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 10 µg/mL NeutrAvidin working solution to each well, incubate 30 min at RT on the rocker (20 osc/min); ensure full coverage.

steps.title: Rinse NeutrAvidin coating
steps.instruction: Remove NeutrAvidin solution and rinse each well four times with 200 µL sterile DPBS at RT, avoiding tip contact with the surface.

steps.title: Apply protein-specific coating
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL anti‑CD16 solution to the designated positive‑control well and 200 µL HER2 working solution to the remaining seven wells; incubate 30 min at RT on the rocker (20 osc/min).

steps.title: Rinse protein coatings
steps.instruction: Remove the protein solutions and rinse each well four times with 200 µL sterile DPBS; change pipette tips between anti‑CD16 and HER2 wells to prevent cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Add RPMI medium before imaging
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL RPMI supplemented medium to each well and incubate 15 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Isolate primary human NK cells
steps.instruction: Isolate NK cells from 30 mL concentrated blood platelet suspension using the MACSxpress Human NK Cell Isolation kit; characterize by flow cytometry with anti‑CD16, anti‑CD3, and anti‑CD56 antibodies; use cells within 24 h and handle all blood work in a Class II biosafety cabinet with appropriate PPE.

steps.title: Resuspend NK cells at working density
steps.instruction: Resuspend NK cells at 2 × 10⁵ cells/mL in complete RPMI 1640 medium (prepared in step 9).

steps.title: Pre‑incubate NK cells with bsAb
steps.instruction: Add bispecific antibody (0.14–14 000 pM) to the NK cell suspension (diluted in BSA 0.2 % immediately before use) and incubate 30 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; this pre‑incubation ensures receptor engagement.

steps.title: Add medium to coated slide
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL RPMI supplemented medium to each well of the Ibidi slide and place the slide on a microscope stage pre‑heated to 37 °C.

steps.title: Seed NK cells onto coated wells
steps.instruction: Remove the medium from each well and add 200 µL pre‑incubated NK cell suspension to each HER2‑coated well; add 200 µL NK cell suspension without bsAb to the anti‑CD16 control well; avoid air bubbles.

steps.title: Live RICM imaging
steps.instruction: Start imaging immediately after cell addition; acquire time‑lapse images every 15–20 s, cycling through 16 positions per well for a total of 10 min; use a 63× oil‑immersion objective (NA ≥ 1.25), set Köhler illumination, keep exposure ~100 ms, maintain the sample at 37 °C (stage‑top incubator), CO₂ optional for >30 min.

steps.title: Isolate NK cells for cell‑cell assay
steps.instruction: Repeat NK cell isolation as described in step 13; use cells within the next 24 h.

steps.title: Stain NK cells with CFSE
steps.instruction: Collect the required number of NK cells for the desired effector‑to‑target (E:T) ratio, centrifuge 600 × g for 5 min at RT, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in CFSE dilution (0.2 µL CFSE per 1 × 10⁶ cells in 1 mL DPBS pre‑warmed to 37 °C); incubate 20 min at 37 °C with the tube lid slightly open; protect from light.

steps.title: Quench CFSE staining
steps.instruction: Add five‑fold volume of supplemented RPMI (e.g., 5 mL per 1 mL CFSE solution) to reach a final volume of ~6 mL; mix gently by repetitive pipetting and incubate 5 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash stained NK cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 600 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in supplemented RPMI to the desired final concentration, keep protected from light until use.

steps.title: Seed target MCF7 cells
steps.instruction: Seed 60 000–80 000 MCF7‑WT or MCF7‑HER2⁺ cells per well of an 8‑well slide in 300 µL supplemented RPMI; incubate overnight (≈18 h) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 85–95 % humidity to reach 70–80 % confluence.

steps.title: Stain target nuclei with Hoechst
steps.instruction: Aspirate media, add 200 µL/well Hoechst 33342 (5 µg/mL final) prepared by diluting 1 µL of 10 mg/mL stock in 2 mL RPMI; incubate 15 min at 37 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Rinse Hoechst‑stained targets
steps.instruction: Remove Hoechst solution and rinse each well three times with 300 µL warm supplemented RPMI; aspirate one well at a time to avoid drying.

steps.title: Prepare bispecific antibody dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute bispecific antibody in supplemented RPMI to the desired concentration (typically 0.1–1 000 pM) so that each well will receive a final volume of 300 µL.

steps.title: Add PI and bsAb to target wells
steps.instruction: From the slide, gently remove existing medium (one well at a time); add 150 µL/well RPMI containing propidium iodide (final 4 µg/mL, prepared by diluting 10 µL of 1 mg/mL PI stock in 1.25 mL RPMI) and then add 50 µL of the appropriate bsAb dilution to reach 300 µL total per well.

steps.title: Select imaging fields
steps.instruction: Place the slide on an inverted microscope with a 37 °C stage; using Micro‑Manager, select fields of view with 40–80 % target confluence, avoiding multilayer regions; verify nuclei focus with the UV filter and save positions.

steps.title: Add stained NK effectors
steps.instruction: Add the CFSE‑stained NK cells to each well at the predetermined E:T ratio (e.g., for 5:1 ratio add 300 000 NK cells to a well containing 60 000 targets).

steps.title: Configure multi‑channel acquisition
steps.instruction: In Micro‑Manager, set up acquisition of four channels (brightfield, PI, CFSE, Hoechst), add a Z‑offset if needed (target nuclei lower than brightfield, effectors higher), and choose either 20×/0.8 or 40×/1.3 objective.

steps.title: Perform time‑lapse fluorescence imaging
steps.instruction: Capture 5–9 fields per well over 2–5 h with intervals of 3–20 min between frames; alternate transmitted light and epifluorescence for each channel; keep exposure low to avoid bleaching.

steps.title: Dispose of samples after imaging
steps.instruction: After the experiment, discard all media and cells according to biosafety regulations for hazardous biological waste.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol has been used and validated in the following research article(s): • Torro et al. [16]. Celldetective: an AI-enhanced image analysis tool for unraveling dynamic cell interactions. eLife14:RP105302 (doi.org/10.7554/eLife.105302.1)
